#### Figure 2 Map 
#### Completed via in Canva customization adding legend and inset map

```{r}
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(here)
library(maps)  # for inset map

# ----------------------------
# Load data
# ----------------------------
file_path <- here("data", "raw","MetroVan_LCC_2020_Final.tif")
lcc2020 <- rast(file_path)

load(here("data", "sites_3857.Rdata"))
sites_3857 <- sites_3857[-c(8),]  # remove one site if needed

sites_matched <- st_transform(sites_3857, crs(lcc2020))

# Crop raster to sites + buffer
site_extent <- ext(vect(sites_matched))
site_extent_buffered <- ext(
  xmin(site_extent) - 1500,
  xmax(site_extent) + 1500,
  ymin(site_extent) - 1500,
  ymax(site_extent) + 1500
)
lcc2020_crop <- crop(lcc2020, site_extent_buffered)

# Land cover classes
lc_classes <- data.frame(
  value = 1:14,
  label = c(
    "Buildings", "Paved", "Other Built", "Barren", "Soil",
    "Coniferous", "Shrub","Deciduous", "Modified Grass",
    "Natural Grass", "Non-Photo Veg.", "Shadow",
    "Water", "Snow/Ice"
  )
)
levels(lcc2020_crop) <- lc_classes

earthy_colors <- c(
  "firebrick", "#7f7f7f", "pink", "lightyellow", "brown4",
  "#1b7837", "green", "#4daf4a", "darkolivegreen1",
  "darkolivegreen3", "lemonchiffon2", "black", "#2c7bb6", "#ffffff"
)

# Site labels
site_labels <- c(
  "Collingwood", "McKenzie", "Shaugnessy", "Queen Elizabeth",
  "False Creek", "Downtown", "West End", "43 & Churchill",
  "14 & Spruce", "19 & Yukon", "Strathcona", "2nd Beach"
)

# Centroids & label offsets
site_centroids <- st_centroid(sites_matched)
label_coords <- st_coordinates(site_centroids)

# Bottom of map for “center” push
bottom_y <- min(label_coords[,2]) - 500
center_x <- mean(label_coords[,1])
label_center <- c(center_x, bottom_y)

# Direction vectors and normalization
dx <- label_coords[,1] - label_center[1]
dy <- label_coords[,2] - label_center[2]
dist <- sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2)
dx_norm <- dx / dist
dy_norm <- dy / dist
push_dist <- 550

label_coords_offset <- label_coords
label_coords_offset[,1] <- label_coords[,1] + dx_norm * push_dist
label_coords_offset[,2] <- label_coords[,2] + dy_norm * push_dist

# Specific vertical adjustments
i_col <- which(site_labels == "Collingwood")
i_mck <- which(site_labels == "McKenzie")
label_coords_offset[i_col,2] <- label_coords_offset[i_col,2] + 120
label_coords_offset[i_mck,2] <- label_coords_offset[i_mck,2] + 300
label_coords_offset[i_col,1] <- label_coords_offset[i_col,1] - 120
label_coords_offset[i_mck,1] <- label_coords_offset[i_mck,1] + 300

# ----------------------------
# Plot figure
# ----------------------------

pdf(here("figs", "Figure2.pdf"), width = 15, height = 12)

# 1. Layout: main map + legend
layout(matrix(c(1,2), ncol = 2), widths = c(4,1))
par(mar = c(3,4,3,0))

# Main map
plot(lcc2020_crop,
     main = "",
     col = earthy_colors,
     type = "classes",
     axes = FALSE,
     legend = FALSE)
plot(st_geometry(sites_matched), add = TRUE, lwd = 4, border = "black")

# Labels with halo
segments(label_coords[,1], label_coords[,2],
         label_coords_offset[,1], label_coords_offset[,2],
         col = "black", lwd = 3)
offsets <- expand.grid(dx = c(-1,0,1), dy = c(-1,0,1))
for(i in 1:nrow(offsets)) {
  if(offsets$dx[i]!=0 | offsets$dy[i]!=0){
    text(label_coords_offset[,1]+offsets$dx[i]*20,
         label_coords_offset[,2]+offsets$dy[i]*20,
         labels = site_labels,
         cex=1.5,font=2,col="black")
  }
}
text(label_coords_offset,
     labels=site_labels,cex=1.5,font=2,col="white")

# -------------------
# North arrow (triangle style)
# -------------------
x_arrow <- xmax(site_extent_buffered) - 1000
y_arrow <- ymax(site_extent_buffered) - 1000
arrow_height <- 600
arrow_width <- 200
polygon(x=c(x_arrow-arrow_width/2, x_arrow+arrow_width/2, x_arrow),
        y=c(y_arrow, y_arrow, y_arrow+arrow_height),
        col="black")
text(x_arrow, y_arrow + arrow_height + 200, "N", font=2, cex=1.5)

# -------------------
# Scale bar upper-left
# -------------------
scale_x <- xmin(site_extent_buffered) + 500
scale_y <- ymax(site_extent_buffered) - 700
rect(scale_x, scale_y, scale_x + 500, scale_y + 50, col="black")
rect(scale_x + 500, scale_y, scale_x + 1000, scale_y + 50, col="white")
text(scale_x + 250, scale_y + 100, "500 m", cex=1.2)
text(scale_x + 750, scale_y + 100, "1000 m", cex=1.2)

# -------------------
# Inset map (top-right)
# -------------------
par(fig=c(0.65,0.95,0.7,0.95), new=TRUE, mar=c(0,0,0,0))
map("world", regions=c("Canada","USA"), fill=TRUE, col="lightgrey", border="white", lwd=0.5)
study_centroid <- st_coordinates(st_centroid(st_union(sites_matched)))
points(study_centroid[,1], study_centroid[,2], pch=19, col="red", cex=2)

# -------------------
# Legend (right panel)
# -------------------
par(mar=c(2,0,2,0))
plot.new()
plot.window(xlim=c(0,1), ylim=c(0,1))
legend(x=-0.13, y=0.7,
       legend=lc_classes$label,
       fill=earthy_colors,
       border="black",
       cex=1.8,
       bty="n",
       title="Land Cover",
       xjust=0)

dev.off()
```
### Figure 3

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggridges)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)
library(here)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# === Load posterior samples ===
load(file = here("data", "fit_hier_ZIW_A_FA1_FA3_B_roadweight_noub.Rdata"))
posterior <- rstan::extract(fit_hier_ZIW_A_FA1_FA3_B_roadweight_noub)

# === Figure 3a: Ridge Plot ===
posterior_df <- data.frame(
  beta1 = posterior$beta1,
  beta2 = posterior$beta2,
  delta1 = posterior$delta1
)

posterior_long <- pivot_longer(posterior_df, cols = everything(), names_to = "parameter", values_to = "value")

param_colors <- c("beta1" = "purple", "beta2" = "purple", "delta1" = "orange")

plot_a <- ggplot(posterior_long, aes(x = value, y = parameter, fill = parameter)) +
  geom_density_ridges(
    scale = 2.5,
    alpha = 0.6,
    color = "white",
    rel_min_height = 0.01
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = param_colors) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = c(
    "beta1" = "Housing-tenure—density Scale \n Effect on Quantity",
    "beta2" = "Enfranchisement Scale \n Effect on Quantity",
    "delta1" = "Service Roads \n Effect on Absence"
  )) +
  labs(
    x = "Coefficient Value",
    y = NULL #,
    #title = "(a)"
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = -0.1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      color = c("purple", "purple", "orange")[order(unique(posterior_long$parameter))]
    )
  )

# === Figure 3b: Spatial Map ===

# Medians
mu_med     <- median(posterior$mu0)
beta1_med  <- median(posterior$beta1)
beta2_med  <- median(posterior$beta2)
gamma_med  <- median(posterior$gamma)
delta1_med <- median(posterior$delta1)
delta2_med <- median(posterior$delta2)
alpha_med  <- median(posterior$alpha)

# Load spatial data
load(file = here("data", "van_dat_final_750.Rdata"))

# Predict
X1 <- van_dat$Factor1_wins
X2 <- van_dat$Factor3_wins
P1 <- van_dat$service_road_weight

log_scale <- mu_med + beta1_med * X1 + beta2_med * X2
sigma <- exp(log_scale)
weibull_mean <- sigma * gamma(1 + 1 / alpha_med)
pi <- plogis(gamma_med + delta1_med * P1)
expected_y <- (1 - pi) * weibull_mean

predicted_fw_score <- st_sf(
  geometry = st_geometry(van_dat),
  expected_fw_score = expected_y
)

#### Saves predicted wildlife-accessible food waste median predictions for use elsewhere
#saveRDS(predicted_fw_score, here("data/fw_score_median_preds_750m.rds"))

# Map (plot_b) — keep legend, remove axis ticks/labels, shrink margins
plot_b <- ggplot(predicted_fw_score) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = expected_fw_score), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "inferno",
    trans = "log10",
    name = "Expected FW Score",
    limits = c(0.0005, max(predicted_fw_score$expected_fw_score)),
    breaks = c(0.0005, 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10, 70),
    labels = c("0", "0.01", "0.1", "1", "10", "70")
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  #labs(title = "(b)") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = -0.1),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),        # Remove lat/lon labels
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),       # Remove tick marks
    axis.title = element_blank(),       # Remove axis titles
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.position = "right",          # Ensure it stays beside the map
    plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 5, b = 5, l = 5)
  )



# Ridge plot (plot_a)
plot_a <- plot_a +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)
  )

# Map (plot_b)
plot_b <- plot_b +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2),  # pull map left
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.justification = "center",
    legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, -10),  # pull legend closer
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  ) +
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE)


combined_plot <- ggdraw() +
  draw_plot(plot_a, x = 0, y = 0.55, width = 1, height = 0.4) +
  draw_plot(plot_b, x = 0, y = 0, width = 1, height = 0.6) +  # adjust x/y if needed
  draw_plot_label(
    label = c("(a)", "(b)"),
    x = c(0.015, 0.015),
    y = c(0.98, 0.52),  # this y for (b) puts it *just above* plot_b
    size = 14,
    fontface = "bold"
  )

# === Save ===
ggsave(
  filename = here("figs", "Figure3.pdf"),
  plot = combined_plot,
  width = 4.875,
  height = 5.5, 
  dpi = 300
)
```

#### Figure 4

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)
library(here)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)

# =========================================================
# 1. LOAD DATA + POSTERIORS (MAIN MODEL)
# =========================================================

load(file = here("data", "fit_hier_ZIW_A_FA1_FA3_B_roadweight_noub.Rdata"))
posterior_main <- rstan::extract(fit_hier_ZIW_A_FA1_FA3_B_roadweight_noub)

load(file = here("data", "van_dat_final_750.Rdata"))

# --- Main model parameters (ZIW / Weibull process model)
mu_med     <- median(posterior_main$mu0)
beta1_med  <- median(posterior_main$beta1)
beta2_med  <- median(posterior_main$beta2)
gamma_med  <- median(posterior_main$gamma)
delta1_med <- median(posterior_main$delta1)
alpha_med  <- median(posterior_main$alpha)

# Predict
X1 <- van_dat$Factor1_wins
X2 <- van_dat$Factor3_wins
P1 <- van_dat$service_road_weight

log_scale <- mu_med + beta1_med * X1 + beta2_med * X2
sigma <- exp(log_scale)
weibull_mean <- sigma * gamma(1 + 1 / alpha_med)
pi <- plogis(gamma_med + delta1_med * P1)
expected_y <- (1 - pi) * weibull_mean

predicted_fw_score <- st_sf(
  geometry = st_geometry(van_dat),
  expected_fw_score = expected_y
)

# =========================================================
# 2. LOAD PROXY MODEL (TWEEDIE)
# =========================================================

load(file = here("data", "fit_hier_1pred_tweedie.Rdata"))
posterior_proxy <- rstan::extract(fit_hier_1pred_tweedie)

mu0_med   <- median(posterior_proxy$mu0)
beta1_med <- median(posterior_proxy$beta1)

X1_proxy <- van_dat$nearest_food_retail

eta <- mu0_med + beta1_med * X1_proxy
proxy_mean <- exp(eta)

pred_proxy <- st_sf(
  geometry = st_geometry(van_dat),
  value = proxy_mean
)

# =========================================================
# 3. DIFFERENCE (LOG SCALE = BEST PRACTICE)
# =========================================================

pred_diff <- st_sf(
  geometry = st_geometry(van_dat),
  value = log10(predicted_fw_score$expected_fw_score + 1e-6) - log10(pred_proxy$value + 1e-6)
)

# =========================================================
# 4. SHARED THEME (PUBLICATION-READY)
# =========================================================

map_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, hjust = 0),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
  )

# =========================================================
# 5. PLOT (A) MAIN MODEL
# =========================================================

plot_a <- ggplot(predicted_fw_score) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = expected_fw_score), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "inferno",
    trans = "log10",
    name = "Expected FW Score",
    limits = c(0.0005, max(predicted_fw_score$expected_fw_score)),
    breaks = c(0.0005, 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10, 70),
    labels = c("0", "0.01", "0.1", "1", "10", "70")
  ) +
  labs(title = "(a) Process model") +
  map_theme


# =========================================================
# 6. PLOT (B) PROXY MODEL
# =========================================================

plot_b <- ggplot(pred_proxy) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = value), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "inferno",
    trans = "log10",
    name = "Expected FW Score",
    limits = c(0.0005, max(predicted_fw_score$expected_fw_score)),
    breaks = c(0.0005, 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10, 70),
    labels = c("0", "0.01", "0.1", "1", "10", "70")
  ) +
  labs(title = "(b) Proxy model") +
  map_theme



# =========================================================
# 6. PLOT (B) PROXY MODEL
# =========================================================

plot_c <- ggplot(pred_proxy) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = value), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "inferno",
    trans = "log10",
    name = "Expected FW Score",
    limits = c(0.08,0.17),
    breaks = c(0.08,0.1,0.12,0.14,0.16),
    labels = c("0.08","0.1","0.12","0.14","0.16")
  ) +
  labs(title = "(c) Proxy model") +
  map_theme


# =========================================================
# 7. PLOT (C) DIFFERENCE
# =========================================================

# plot_c <- ggplot(pred_diff) +
#   geom_sf(aes(fill = value), color = NA) +
#   scale_fill_gradient2(
#     low = "#2166AC", 
#     mid = "white",
#     high = "#B2182B"
#     midpoint = 0,
#     name = "log ratio"
#   ) +
#   labs(title = "(c) Log difference") +
#   map_theme
# 

plot_d <- ggplot(pred_diff) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = value), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_scico(
    palette = "vik",
    midpoint = 0,
    name = "log ratio"
  ) +
  labs(title = "(d) Log difference") +
  map_theme


# =========================================================
# 8. COMBINE
# =========================================================

# Top row: process-based and proxy models
top_row <- plot_grid(
  plot_a,
  plot_b,
  #labels = c("a", "b"),
  nrow = 1,
  align = "hv",
  axis = "tblr"
)

bottom_row <- plot_grid(
  plot_c,
  plot_d,
  nrow = 1,
  align = "hv",
  axis = "tblr",
  rel_widths = c(1, 1),
  rel_heights = c(1,1)
)

# Stack rows vertically
final_plot <- plot_grid(
  top_row,
  bottom_row,
  ncol = 1,
  rel_heights = c(1, 1)
)

ggsave(
  filename = here("figs", "Figure4.pdf"),
  plot = final_plot,
  device = "pdf",
  width = 10,
  height = 8.3333334,
  units = "in"
)



```
